transcript: Want to prepare for DP 700 without buying a course? Start with Microsoft's own resources. First, open the Fabric Data Engineer Certification page on Microsoft Learn. Use the study guide to see the skills the exam measures. Then work through the free, self-paced learning material linked from that page. Use the free practice assessment to find the areas you still need to study. Try the exam sandbox so the interface is familiar before exam day. Preparation is free. An exam booking is a separate purchase unless you have a valid offer. Save the official certification page. Check any vouchers eligibility and deadline before relying on it.
